title: Integrated squeeze from the derivative comparison (Simon Ch. 4, 3.4-3.5 with corrected prefactors)
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (w : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (φ Ψ F : ℝ → ℝ) (S ε c σ ρ : ℝ), 0 < ε → μ (closedBall y S) < ⊤ → AEStronglyMeasurable w μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ 1) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ s : ℝ, s ≤ 1 → φ s = 1) → (∀ s : ℝ, 1 + ε ≤ s → φ s = 0) → 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → (1 + ε) * ρ < S → (∀ t : ℝ, σ ≤ t → t ≤ ρ → Real.exp (-c) ≤ F t ∧ F t ≤ Real.exp c) → (∀ t : ℝ, σ ≤ t → t ≤ ρ → HasDerivAt Ψ (F t * ((-(∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * w x ∂μ) / t) / t ^ n)) t) → Real.exp (-c) * ∫ x, (φ (‖x - y‖ / ρ) - φ (‖x - y‖ / σ)) * (w x / ‖x - y‖ ^ n) ∂μ ≤ Ψ ρ - Ψ σ ∧ Ψ ρ - Ψ σ ≤ Real.exp c * (1 + ε) ^ n * ∫ x, (φ (‖x - y‖ / ρ) - φ (‖x - y‖ / σ)) * (w x / ‖x - y‖ ^ n) ∂μ
